title: mailtestenv env document, version 1
description: What `testenv.sh env --json` prints and `testenv.sh up` writes to STATE/env.json. File paths are relative to the state directory (the directory that holds env.json). Version 1 may gain optional members; a change that breaks a version-1 reader increments `version`.

state_dir.description: Absolute state directory as the producer saw it. Readers that see the state at another path resolve file paths against the directory of env.json instead.

path.description: Relative to the state directory; never absolute, no .. segments

host.description: Every endpoint listens on host loopback only.

server_names.description: Names to send as SNI and to validate the certificate against; the first is the primary name.

ca.description: PEM CA certificate that issues the role's server certificates (null: no TLS).

secrets.description: TSV with header `account kind host secret`; kinds: password and the oauth.token_kinds. Replaced by rename; read it when a run starts.

accounts_file.description: TSV whose first column lists the users, after a header line (for roles with many users).

password.description: The fixed password of every account (null: per-account passwords in `secrets`).

valid.description: SNI names that get the valid chain.

wrong_name.description: Served for any other SNI name (or none): valid chain, wrong name.

untrusted_issuer.description: SNI name that gets a certificate with the right name from an untrusted CA.

token_kinds.description: `kind` values in `secrets`; the first is the valid access token.

port.description: Host port; 143 and 5232 are never used.

tls.description: none: plain only; starttls: STARTTLS required before authentication; starttls-optional: offered, plain allowed; implicit: TLS from the first byte.
